items.title: Real yields climb after a stronger-than-expected jobs report
items.summary: Bond yields adjusted for inflation rose after hiring data beat expectations, raising the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding metals.

items.title: Central banks keep adding to reserves, survey finds
items.summary: A survey of reserve managers found several central banks still plan to increase gold holdings over the coming year.

items.title: Mine output holds steady in the third quarter
items.summary: Producers reported quarterly output broadly in line with plans.
